name: auto-increment-assigns-on-insert
$comment: autoIncrementField (server-assigned per-table counter): an insert that supplies a client value has it overwritten by the next sequence value, and an insert that omits the field gets the next value — both as int64 decimal strings. Assignment is strictly increasing in insert order; upsert's insert branch assigns the same way. The follow-up collect reads both rows back with the assigned counters.
